detail.longDescription: Now we are rolling all these achievements back. Back to mainframes / clouds instead of computers at home and move back the programming skills to the mainframes, but this time not to the humans operating them but to some software. So why should I still code? Or do any creative work at all? To feed the copyright infringment machine and make some billionaires more billionaire? Time to go to live in a lonely shed in the woods. 🧵 5/5 # noai # coding # programming # retrocomputing # homecomputer
